simple.meaning: חָכָם (châkâm) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “wise , (i.e. intelligent, skilful or artful).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 137 times across Genesis, Exodus, Deuteronomy, Judges, 2 Samuel, and 8 more, beginning at Genesis 41:8. Its contexts include family line, priesthood, land, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חָכָם (H2450).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.

definitions.full: H2450. chakam חָכָם adjective wise , ׳ח Deut 4:6 67t.; construct חֲכַם Isa 3:3 9 t.; plural חֲכָמִים Deut 1:13 39 t.; construct חַכְמֵי Exod 28:3-4 t.; suffix חֲכָמֶיךָ Isa 19:12 etc. + 8 t.; feminine חֲכָמָה 2Sam 14:2 ; 20:16 ; construct חַכְמַת Exod 35:25 ; plural חֲכָמוֺת Jer 9:16 ; construct חַכְמוֺת Judg 5:29 ; Prov 14:1 (but read חָכְמוֺת De) — 1 skilful in technical work; artificers Isa 3:3 ; sailors Ezek 27:8 , so (probably) 27:9 ; mourning women Jer 9:16 ; artisans of tabernacle and temple and their furniture Exod 28:3 ; 31:6 ; 35:10 ; 36:1-2 , 4 , 8 (P), 1Chr 22:15 ; 2Chr 2:6 ; 2:12 ; 2:13 (twice in verse); women in spinning Exod 35:25 (P); goldsmiths and other artisans Jer 10:9 ; makers of idol-images Isa 40:20 . 2 wise in the administration of affairs: Joseph in Egypt Gen 41:33 , 39 (E); heads of tribes Deut 1:13 , 15 ; Judg 16:19 ; David 2Sam 14:20 , of Solomon 1Kin 2:9 ; 3:12 ; 1 Kings 5:21 2Chr 2:11 ; the prince of Tyre, in satire Ezek 28:3 ; of kings in General Prov 20:26 ; class of political advisers of Judah Isa 29:14 ; Jer 18:18 , apparently also Isa 5:21 ; of Egypt 19:11 (twice in verse); 19:12 , Edom Obadiah 8, the nations Jer 10:7 ; so of God Isa 31:2 . 3 shrewd, crafty, cunning: Jonadab 2Sam 13:3 ; the princesses Judg 5:29 ; חכמה אשׁה wise woman 2Sam 14:2 ; 20:16 ; Generally, Jer 9:22 ; intelligent animals Prov 30:24 ; ח ׳לכד בערמם taking the cunning in their craft Job 5:13 ; בעיני חכם wise in one's own eyes Prov 3:7 ; 26:5 , 12 , 16 ; 28:11 ; לב חכמי wise of mind (in their own mind) Job 37:24 . 4 plural class of learned and shrewd men, including astrologers, magicians and the like, of Egypt Gen 41:8 (E), Exod 7:11 (P; compare Isa 19:11 (twice in verse); 19:12 ); Babylon 44:25 ; Jer 50:35 ; 51:57 ; Persia Est 1:13 ; 6:13 . 5 prudent , towards king Prov 16:14 ; in controversies 11:29 ; 29:8-9 , 11 ; religious affairs Hosea 13:13 ; Hosea 14:10; Jer 4:22 ; 8:8-9 , Deut 4:6 ; 32:6 ; Psa 107:43 ; ׳ח אישׁ Jer 9:11 . 6 wise , ethically and religiously,. in Wisdom Literature: a. as adjective, לֵב חֲכַם wise of mind Prov 10:8 ; 16:21 ; חָכָם לֵב Eccl 8:5 ; of the son Prov 10:1 = 15:20 ; 13:1 ; 23:24 ; Eccl 2:19 ; ח ׳ילד 4:13 wise boy ; ח ׳גבר Job 34:34 wise man ; ח ׳מוכיח wise reprover Prov 25:12 . b. = substantive: (1) as a wise learner in school of wisdom, he fears God and departs from evil Prov 14:16 ; is silent 17:28 ; hearkens to counsel 12:15 ; hears and increases in learning 1:5 ; his ear seeketh knowledge 18:15 ; he receives it 21:11 ; and stores it up 10:14 ; his ears hearken to the reproof which giveth life 15:31 ; and he becomes wiser through it 9:8-9 ,. (2) as a wise teacher, a sage , he does not answer with windy knowledge Job 15:2 ; he tells the experience of the past Job 15:48; has knowledge 34:2 ; teaches it Eccl 12:9 ; disperses it Prov 15:7 ; his tongue is health 12:18 ; it utters knowledge aright 15:2 ; his mind instructs his mouth and adds learning to his lips 16:23 ; his words are gracious Eccl 10:12 ; it is good to hear his rebuke 7:5 ; his instruction is a fountain of life Prov 13:14 ; one walking with him becomes wiser 13:20 . The חכמים recall the Greek σόφοι , having their schools, pupils ( בֵן ), discipline ( מוּסָר ), principles and collections of wisdom, חכמים דברי 1:6 ; 22:17 (compare 24:23 ), Eccl 9:17 ; 12:11 ; God himself is לבב חכם Job 9:4 . (3) the wise are prosperous: true, in sceptical view of Ecclesiastes, they have no advantage over the fool Eccl 6:8 ; but die as the fool 2:16 (twice in verse); Psa 49:11 ; they will not be able to find the works of God Eccl 8:17 ; like others are in the hands of God 9:1 ; they do not secure bread 9:11 ; but elsewhere reverse is true: precious treasure is in his dwelling Prov 21:20 ; his lips preserve him 14:3 ; they inherit glory 3:35 ; wealth is their crown 14:24 ; the wise man is strong 24:5 ; Eccl 7:19 ; his eyes are in his head 2:14 ; his mind is at his right hand 10:2 ; he interprets things 8:1 (4) the wise man is a blessing to others: he wins men Prov 11:30 ; scales the city of the mighty 21:22 ; though poor he delivers the city Eccl 9:15 ; is a reproof to scorners Prov 15:12 ; his mind is in the house of mourning Eccl 7:4 ; injustice makes him foolish 7:7 ; Job finds no wise men among his cruel friends Job 17:10 .
